_about: Phase 5 (investigation memory) criteria and design, pre-registered 2026-11-22 before any memory code, data or scenario existed. Judged by mdqc.verify_phase5. No paid model call in this phase (the project's only paid run is Phase 6); multi-session behaviour is exercised with the scripted stand-in, and Phase 6 measures whether the real model uses memory well.

design.store: PostgreSQL schema `memory` (created if missing, never dropped by the data loader): investigation (title, product code, manufacturer, status), memory_item (kind, text, evidence citations, status, session, source), session (start/end), memory_event (audit trail WITHOUT content: item id, kind, action, time)
design.write_path: only through explicit calls: the assistant's memory tools (remember, recall, update_memory, forget) or the user's API/CLI; every save returns a confirmation that is shown to the user
design.read_path: at the start of every session the investigation's current memory is rendered into a block added to the system prompt; recall returns the same content on demand
design.guardrails: an item needs an open investigation; text 5-500 characters; evidence may only cite report keys and recall numbers that exist in core.fact_report / core.fact_recall; text with an email address or phone number is rejected; at most 200 items per investigation
design.deletion: forget / delete_item removes the row; delete_investigation removes the investigation with its items and sessions; the audit trail keeps only ids, kinds, actions and times, never text; export writes everything that is stored, so the user can see there is nothing else

scenarios.S_A: Insulet pods (LZG): session 1 investigates adhesive failures and saves a ruled-out item, a hypothesis and an open question; session 2 starts with that memory in context and answers 'what have we ruled out?' from it; the user deletes the hypothesis; session 3's context and recall no longer contain it
scenarios.S_B: Exactech knees (JWH): saves a decision citing a real recall and a ruled-out item citing a real report; an attempt to cite an invented report key and one with a phone number are rejected; the user edits the decision; export matches the database
scenarios.S_C: two investigations kept apart: session for investigation B never sees investigation A's items; deleting investigation A removes all of its rows

criteria.M1_store_correct: API create/read/edit/delete/export round trips are exact (unit tests on a real PostgreSQL), constraints hold (kinds, lengths, one investigation per item), and the schema survives a data reload of `core`
criteria.M2_cross_session: in every scenario, each session's memory block contains exactly the investigation's items that exist at that session's start (none missing, none deleted, none from another investigation); the verifier rebuilds the expected block from its own SQL and compares
criteria.M3_deletion_real: after each deletion the verifier scans every text and jsonb column of every table in schema `memory` for the deleted text: zero hits; deleted ids are absent; the audit trail holds no text; deleting an investigation leaves zero rows that reference it
criteria.M4_guardrails: invented evidence, email/phone text, empty or over-long text, wrong kind, closed or missing investigation are all rejected with an error result (never stored); every successful save returns a confirmation the answer shows
criteria.M5_export_ci: export (JSON and Markdown) equals the database content exactly; memory tests run in CI against a PostgreSQL service; the scripted multi-session recordings replay offline
